root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from the `dma_free_coherent()` function in the `ec_bhf` driver receiving the buffer allocation length (`priv->rx_buf.alloc_len`) instead of the physical DMA address (`priv->rx_buf.alloc_phys`) as the DMA handle argument during error cleanup.
root_cause.evidence: The provided patch diff modifies the `dma_free_coherent()` call in `drivers/net/ethernet/ec_bhf.c` by replacing the fourth argument `priv->rx_buf.alloc_len` with `priv->rx_buf.alloc_phys` in the `error_rx_free` section.
